Rabri Devi Vacates Patna Bungalow Amidst Deadline and Inventory Dispute

Former Bihar Chief Minister Rabri Devi has begun vacating her official residence at 10 Circular Road in Patna as a deadline expired. The bungalow has been allotted to the Dairy and Fisheries Minister. While the process of vacating has started, a dispute over an inventory list from 2006 has reportedly caused delays in the full handover.
